autoRepay(uint256,uint256).details: Called automatically by DeltaNeutralVault after harvestToUSDC()      No Ballet signature required — fully automated.      Yield pays debt. Capacity restores. Re-borrow when ready.

params.amount: USDC from yield already in this contract

borrowUSDC(uint256,uint256[],uint256).details: Full automated flow:      1. Verifies token IDs are locked in WhaleVault      2. Reads face value snapshotted at lock time      3. Calculates credit limit = faceValueUSD × min(tier LTV)      4. Checks Aave health factor ≥ 1.5x      5. Borrows USDC from Aave v3 pool      6. Sends USDC directly to Ballet wallet — hardcoded      INV-3: USDC destination is BALLET_WALLET constant.      It cannot be redirected. It is in the bytecode.

params.tokenIds: Token IDs in the lock (for tier LTV calculation)

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

repayUSDC(uint256,uint256).details: Wayne sends USDC from Ballet wallet. Contract repays Aave.      Once debt is cleared, same lockId can borrow again.

params.amount: USDC to repay (use type(uint256).max for full repay)
